Our reactions to conflicts were learned early in our lives. These patterns are well ingrained into our adult behaviour and attitudes. Fortunately we can re-learn and modify the way we react to conflicts.

Reviewing the ways you react to conflict is another piece of the puzzle for understanding how conflicts work. Often a heightened awareness of how we react can help to keep some conflicts from escalating; we can choose how we react. We can actually learn new and better ways to react when we have conflicts.
